summary: Focused bug verification on /finance Retention Advisor modal using loaded skills ai-testing-core and ai-testing-llm. Loader/no-red-error, action-card DOM order above analysis card, AI stream completion (1124 chars with DIAGNOSA/TINDAKAN/TARGET and selesai badge), preventive maintenance success state ('3 tugas dibuat.'), persistence visibility via /maintenance count=22, and X close all passed. Verdict is not_fixed because the modal layout is still broken: computed .advisor-modal is display:block, max-height:none, .advisor-scroll overflow-y:visible; after AI text loads the modal grows to 1190px on a 1080px viewport and the close header is no longer visible.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal layout still broken. Runtime computed styles showed maxHeight='none', display='block', flexDirection='row', .advisor-scroll overflowY='visible'. After AI stream, modal height was 1190.4px on a 1080px viewport and the header close X was not visible, so the required fixed header/footer + internal scroll behavior is not working.

issues: Action cards are now above .advisor-analysis-card and loader appears correctly, but the modal still overflows/looks broken after analysis text fills in.
CSS for .advisor-modal max-height/flex is not applied in the browser, so scrolling is page/modal-overflow behavior instead of internal .advisor-scroll.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/index.css around the AI advisor modal rules so .advisor-modal { max-height: 88vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } and .advisor-scroll { overflow-y:auto; flex:1; min-height:0; } are valid CSS and not overridden by the later generic .modal rule.
Retest /finance modal after CSS fix; specifically verify computed max-height/flex styles and that close X + Copy/Selesai remain visible after scrolling the analysis content.
critical_code_review_comments: Code inspection found malformed CSS near /app/frontend/src/index.css lines ~1490-1503: an earlier .advisor-cursor block is missing its closing brace before the new .advisor-modal rule, causing the browser to ignore the intended .advisor-modal max-height/flex declarations. The later generic .modal rule also appears after advisor rules and can override equal-specificity max-width/padding.

The JSX order in /app/frontend/src/components/RetentionAdvisorModal.jsx is correct: .advisor-actions-grid appears before .advisor-analysis-card inside .advisor-scroll, and state='loading' prevents showing the red error before a real error event.

rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: open /finance, scroll to Renewal Insights, click Tanya ABYNS AI, wait for the AI stream to complete. The analysis text fills the modal; computed .advisor-modal remains display:block/max-height:none and grows past the viewport. Likely RCA is invalid CSS around the advisor modal block in index.css (unclosed .advisor-cursor block before .advisor-modal) plus later .modal rule overriding equal-specificity properties.
